      <h1 class="rv-pillar-hero-headline">Zero to Hero: Kitesurfing, Sri Lanka <em>Learn to kitesurf in one week</em></h1>
      <p class="rv-pillar-hero-sub">Kalpitiya, on Sri Lanka's northwest coast, is where most of the country's kitesurfing happens, thanks to a flat, shallow lagoon that suits complete beginners. Zero to Hero is Ruuk Village's 8-day package that takes a first-timer from kite control to riding independently.</p>
      <div class="rv-pillar-hero-pills">
        <span class="rv-pillar-hero-pill">Max 2 students per instructor</span>
        <span class="rv-pillar-hero-pill">Waist deep, flat water</span>

<!-- BLOCK: intro -->
  <section class="rv-content-section">
    <span class="rv-kicker">One week</span>
    <h2 class="rv-h2">Can you really learn to kitesurf in one week?</h2>
    <p class="rv-sub rv-pkg-narrow">Yes. Most of our guests ride their first metres on their own within one week. Your 12 hours of lessons are spread over four days in flat, waist deep water, with never more than two students per instructor. Then you have three days with your own gear to practise. If a lesson day has no wind, the lesson simply moves into those days.</p>
  </section>

          <li>You love rice and curry cooked over open fire</li>
          <li>You would like to arrive as a guest and leave as a friend</li>

<!-- BLOCK: faq -->
  <section class="rv-content-section">
    <span class="rv-kicker">Good to know</span>
    <h2 class="rv-h2">Questions before you book</h2>
    <div class="rv-faq-list">
      <details class="rv-faq-item"><summary class="rv-faq-q">What if there is no wind?</summary><div class="rv-faq-a"><p class="rv-mini">Your lessons move into the rental days. This is why the course ends with three free days. In the main seasons, days without wind are rare.</p></div></details>
      <details class="rv-faq-item"><summary class="rv-faq-q">When is the best time to come?</summary><div class="rv-faq-a"><p class="rv-mini">Mid December to February is our main season, with steady wind and warm days. June to September is our second season, with strong summer wind and our best prices. See the <a class="rv-link" href="/kalpitiya-wind-season">wind season</a> for details.</p></div></details>
      <details class="rv-faq-item"><summary class="rv-faq-q">My partner does not kite. Can they come?</summary><div class="rv-faq-a"><p class="rv-mini">Of course. They share your cabana and spend the days their own way: yoga, dolphins, a Wilpattu safari, or a book in the hammock. Ask us for the companion price.</p></div></details>
      <details class="rv-faq-item"><summary class="rv-faq-q">I travel alone. Will I be in a group?</summary><div class="rv-faq-a"><p class="rv-mini">Usually not. Solo guests get their own instructor. Private lessons are faster, so 10 private hours take you as far as 12 hours in a group.</p></div></details>
      <details class="rv-faq-item"><summary class="rv-faq-q">Is there an early booking discount?</summary><div class="rv-faq-a"><p class="rv-mini">Yes. Book at least 90 days before arrival and pay the 30% deposit, and you save &euro;50 per person. It is not available from December 15 to January 31.</p></div></details>
      <details class="rv-faq-item"><summary class="rv-faq-q">How do I book?</summary><div class="rv-faq-a"><p class="rv-mini">Send us your dates through Plan Your Trip. We reply within 24 hours with a personal plan. A 30% deposit confirms your booking, and you can change your dates once for free, up to 30 days before arrival.</p></div></details>
    </div>

<script>
(function () {
  var root = document.getElementById('rv-z2h-builder');
  if (!root || root.getAttribute('data-ready')) return;
  root.setAttribute('data-ready', '1');
  /* Prices: edit here when your rates change */
  var BASE = { summer: 740, quiet: 740, winter: 775, busy: 775 };
  var EARLY = 50;               /* early booking: 90+ days ahead, summer and quiet months */
  var LESSON_SUPPLEMENT = 100;  /* private lessons for singles */
  var PEAK_FEE = 35;            /* 7 nights x 5, used for the "booked separately" value */
  var SEASON = { summer: 'June to September', quiet: 'Oct, Nov, March to May', winter: 'Dec 1 to 14, February', busy: 'Dec 15 to Jan 31' };
  var CAB = {
    wadiya: { name: 'Wadiya Cabana', up: 0,   listTwo: 289, listOne: 378 },
    garden: { name: 'Garden Cabana', up: 109, listTwo: 398, listOne: 497 },
    chalet: { name: 'Wooden Chalet', up: 243, listTwo: 532, listOne: 637 }
  };
  var SINGLE = { /* single surcharge for 7 nights; null = on request */
    wadiya: { summer: 45, quiet: 89,  winter: 89,  busy: 213 },
    garden: { summer: 49, quiet: 99,  winter: 99,  busy: 377 },
    chalet: { summer: 52, quiet: 105, winter: 105, busy: null }
  };
  var LIST_LESSONS_TWO = 330, LIST_LESSONS_ONE = 450, LIST_RENTAL = 150, LIST_TRANSFER_PP = 82;
  var PICKUP = 85, DROPOFF = 79, BOTH = 149;
  var s = { season: 'summer', party: 'two', cabana: 'wadiya', early: false, pickup: false, dropoff: false };
  function eur(n) { return '€' + Math.round(n).toLocaleString('en-US'); }
  function all(sel) { return Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll(sel)); }
  function out(name, text) { all('[data-out="' + name + '"]').forEach(function (el) { el.textContent = text; }); }
  root.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var b = e.target.closest('[data-key]');
    if (!b || !root.contains(b)) return;
    var k = b.getAttribute('data-key'), v = b.getAttribute('data-value');
    if (v === null) { s[k] = !s[k]; } else { s[k] = v; if (k === 'season' && (v === 'winter' || v === 'busy')) s.early = false; }
    render();
  });
  function render() {
    all('[data-key]').forEach(function (b) {
      var k = b.getAttribute('data-key'), v = b.getAttribute('data-value');
      b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(v === null ? !!s[k] : s[k] === v));
    });
    var one = s.party === 'one';
    var cab = CAB[s.cabana];
    var winterish = s.season === 'winter' || s.season === 'busy';
    var base = BASE[s.season];
    var earlyOk = s.season === 'summer' || s.season === 'quiet';
    var early = (earlyOk && s.early) ? EARLY : 0;
    var peak = winterish ? PEAK_FEE : 0;
    var single = SINGLE[s.cabana][s.season];
    var onRequest = one && single === null;
    var lines = [['Zero to Hero, 8 days', eur(base)]];
    if (early) lines.push(['Early booking', '−' + eur(early)]);
    if (cab.up) lines.push([cab.name + ' upgrade', '+' + eur(cab.up)]);
    var transfers = 0;
    if (one && !onRequest) {
      lines.push(['Private cabana', '+' + eur(single)]);
      lines.push(['Private lessons, 10 hours', '+' + eur(LESSON_SUPPLEMENT)]);
      if (s.pickup && s.dropoff) transfers = BOTH; else if (s.pickup) transfers = PICKUP; else if (s.dropoff) transfers = DROPOFF;
      if (transfers) lines.push([s.pickup && s.dropoff ? 'Airport pickup and drop off' : (s.pickup ? 'Airport pickup' : 'Airport drop off'), '+' + eur(transfers)]);
    }
    var core = base - early + cab.up + (one ? (single || 0) + LESSON_SUPPLEMENT : 0);
    var price = core + transfers;
    var value = one
      ? cab.listOne + peak + LIST_LESSONS_ONE + LIST_RENTAL
      : cab.listTwo + peak + LIST_LESSONS_TWO + LIST_RENTAL + LIST_TRANSFER_PP;
    var saving = value - core;
    var show = { early: earlyOk, one: one, two: !one, request: onRequest, priced: !onRequest, saving: !onRequest && saving > 0 };
    all('[data-show]').forEach(function (el) { el.hidden = !show[el.getAttribute('data-show')]; });
    var ul = root.querySelector('[data-out="lines"]');
    while (ul.firstChild) ul.removeChild(ul.firstChild);
    lines.forEach(function (l) {
      var li = document.createElement('li');
      var a = document.createElement('span'); a.textContent = l[0];
      var b = document.createElement('span'); b.textContent = l[1];
      li.appendChild(a); li.appendChild(b); ul.appendChild(li);
    });
    out('summary', (one ? 'One person' : 'Two people') + ' · ' + cab.name + ' · ' + SEASON[s.season]);
    out('priceLabel', one ? 'Your price' : 'Price per person');
    out('price', eur(price));
    out('total', eur(price * 2));
    out('value', eur(value));
    out('saving', eur(saving));
    var p = new URLSearchParams();
    p.set('package', 'Zero to Hero, 8 days');
    p.set('period', SEASON[s.season]);
    p.set('guests', one ? '1' : '2');
    p.set('cabana', cab.name);
    p.set('early_booking', early ? 'yes' : 'no');
    if (one) { p.set('pickup', s.pickup ? 'yes' : 'no'); p.set('dropoff', s.dropoff ? 'yes' : 'no'); }
    p.set('estimate', onRequest ? 'on request' : eur(one ? price : price * 2));
    root.querySelector('[data-link="plan"]').setAttribute('href', '/kalpitiya-kitesurfing-stay-booking?' + p.toString());
  }
  render();
})();
</script>
<!-- END BLOCK: cta -->
